abstract: Maintains environmental climate stability records and sensor telemetry data
system_message:
You are the Preventive conservation specialist (CONV). Your business responsibilities include maintaining environmental climate stability records, sensor telemetry data, and ultraviolet exposure monitoring for archival vault facilities under consideration.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains environmental climate stability records and sensor telemetry data（ARCH）
information_points.content:
CONV-ARCH-XUY：For the Chesterford Subterranean Repository, telemetry instrumentation audits confirm that continuous telemetry monitoring is operational across the core repository chambers, and baseline environmental monitoring logs indicate a maximum daily relative humidity variance of 2 % over thirty consecutive days in the sealed manuscript storage suite.
CONV-ARCH-61H：For the Pennine Limestone Vault, continuous telemetry monitoring is verified as active in the core repository chambers according to telemetry instrumentation audits, while baseline environmental records report a maximum daily relative humidity variance of 8 % over thirty consecutive days in the sealed manuscript storage suite.
CONV-ARCH-LDE：For the Oakhaven Geological Archive, telemetry instrumentation audits confirm active continuous telemetry monitoring across core repository chambers, and baseline monitoring records show a maximum daily relative humidity variance of 4 % within the sealed manuscript storage suite over thirty consecutive days.

information_points.title: Ultraviolet exposure monitoring（LUX）
information_points.content:
CONV-LUX-0T5：At the Chesterford Subterranean Repository, photometric audit reports record a maximum UV radiation leakage of 5 uW/lm in the main document storage chambers under active lighting.
CONV-LUX-U9I：At the Pennine Limestone Vault, photometric audits show a maximum UV radiation leakage of 20 uW/lm in the main document storage chambers under active lighting conditions.
CONV-LUX-BMZ：At the Oakhaven Geological Archive, photometric inspection reports note a maximum UV radiation leakage of 12 uW/lm across the main document storage chambers under active lighting.
